decision: Full car = /Scan/'NA Miata NA Miata N2 Aero.stl' (25.0M tris), not the suggested 'Miata CFD Miata cfd full car.stl'
why: The suggested file sits in the Good-Win Ryan customer subfolder and is a winged race car (ortho projection); the brief allows customer folders only if they hold the only full car. N2 Aero is in our own /Scan folder, is a stock-looking NA with hardtop, and the front-end state scans z-fight on it

decision: One rigid levelling transform for every scan (huracan-evo tools/level.py: RANSAC ground plane -> +Z, long axis -> Y, flip_y so the nose is at -Y); ground strips removed with tools/zcut.py (z<6 mm, up-facing below 60 mm, below 75 mm only the tyre patches kept)
why: Raw Artec frame had the car yawed ~25 deg on a sloped floor with two rails under the car; one shared transform keeps all states registered (lesson: never re-normalise separately). First Y-cut clipped the nose (-2080 mm vs bumper tip -2168 mm) - widened

decision: Scan length 3,943 mm (bumper tip -2168 to tail 1775 mm in the levelled frame)
why: Sanity check vs NA spec 3,970 mm; not shown on screen (no text in this reel)

decision: Trunk closed/half/open scans registered by FPFH+RANSAC+ICP (a90-supra tools/globalreg.py) onto the car's rear; one transform for all three
why: They were exported in their own frame (y 3.4-5.0 m away). Trunk closed: same pose 5/5 tries, 98.4 % of points within 8 mm of the car, median 1.7 mm; half/open share the frame (fixed quarters at 1.6-2.1 mm)

decision: Finish panel registered the same way onto the car's tail (12 tries, 0.562 fitness converged in 6)
why: Own frame; overlay render shows it z-fighting on the plate/garnish panel between the tail lamps

decision: Front Bumper Only, Front End Bumper Off, Front End Hood Open used at identity (same Artec frame as the car)
why: Red-over-silver overlays z-fight on fenders/nose; trimmed ICP would only slide them <=26 mm along the skin with no residual gain (bumper p50 7.2->6.3 mm, incl. its inside faces)

decision: Plate characters flattened onto the plate's fitted plane in every scan used (tools/deplate.py); blank plate stays
why: The scan carries a real, legible registration (seen in the tail close-up preview). First try swapped in the 'NA Finish Panel' scan, but that is the inner sheet-metal tail panel around the lamps - it cut the lamp out; reverted

decision: 'NA Finish Panel' not used in any shot
why: Registered fine (z-fights on the tail), but it is a hidden inner panel; exploding it would leave a hole between the lamps and show a part viewers can't place

decision: Hood and trunk lids cut out of the full car along their real panel gaps (tools/cutlid.py, outlines read from a 2 mm top-down seam map); pop-up headlamp doors stay on the car
why: Box cuts would take fender edges or leave lid slivers; the gaps are visible in the 2 mm scan

decision: Lids open on fitted hinges (tools/hinge.py, axis along X): hood -44.4 deg about y=-796 z=840 mm (cowl), trunk 55.6 deg about y=1004 z=925 mm; trunk half-open state = 37.5 deg on the same hinge
why: Fitted closed skin -> captured open lid ('Front End Bumper Off' hood, 'NA Trunk Open'/'Half Open'); overlay renders show the rotated lid z-fighting with the capture. Cost is open->closed because the open hood capture is partial (~2/3 width); first free-axis fit tilted the axis 19 deg (p90 122 mm) - rejected

decision: Lid parts = car skin + the underside captured in the open state, rotated back to closed, keeping only geometry below the skin (tools/lidfull.py)
why: Opened lids show real ribs from below instead of a back-faced shell; first version kept open-capture top-skin points 6-12 mm off the skin and they poked through the hood as patches

decision: Bases (ferrari-296 tools/composite.py): hood shot = car - hood + 'Front End Hood Open' engine bay (z<900 mm); trunk shot = car - lid + 'NA Trunk Open' trunk well; explode = car - hood - lid - front bumper + 'Front End Bumper Off' (z<900, drops its propped hood) + trunk well
why: Lessons: state scans as captured over the trimmed full car; zmax keeps the propped-open hood of the state capture out of the base

decision: Music = mazda-miata-na_track.mp3 (80s synthwave generated for this reel by the coordinating session). Kick grid 0.6068 + 0.5555 n s (108.0 BPM, 1.7 ms rms on 42 kicks); last kick b62 = 35.05 s, decays by 35.6, silent ~37 s
why: Lesson: anchor on kick peaks. First kick pick locked to an off-beat bass phase (0.293 s); a beat-folded band profile showed sub/snare/hats land half a beat later, so the grid was re-anchored on sub-band maxima

decision: Cuts on 8-beat phrase changes (novelty on beat-synced MFCC+chroma): b8 5.05, b16 9.49 (new layer), b18/b20 close-up pair, b24 13.94 (build), b28 16.16 (riser), b32 18.38 = DROP, logo b56 31.71, end b64 36.16 s
why: Cut on accents not only the grid (lesson). Varied holds: 8/8/2/2/4/4/4/24/8 beats

decision: Shot order: front 3/4 turntable (car's right) -> rear 3/4 orbit (left) -> wheel/brake 2 mm -> tail lamp 2 mm -> hood opens -> trunk closed->half->open -> high rear up to top-down on the riser -> exploded view separates ON the drop, drifts while orbiting front-right to side, flies home from b48 and locks on b52, holds 4 beats -> logo
why: Brief's Temerario order; the top-down rise matches the riser and the panels separating is the biggest moment so it gets the drop

decision: Exploded parts: front bumper, hood (with captured underside), trunk lid (with captured underside); stacked above the car (bumper +1.05 m, hood +1.5 m, lid +1.1 m); camera high (4.4 m) so panels show their faces
why: Only scanned removable panels; first layout flew the bumper out of the 9:16 frame and showed the hood/lid edge-on (lesson: keep parts from flying at the lens, stack above)

decision: Close-up camera on the car's right for the hood; engine/trunk shots from high 3/4
why: The captured hood underside covers the right 2/3 of the lid

decision: No text, no HUD
why: Brief + Temerario reference: the scan is the content

decision: s8_explode frames 57-201 re-rendered in fresh Blender processes, 25 frames each (tools/rerender.sh)
why: The single long render went black from frame 57 to the end (mean luma 32 -> 6, sudden). The same frames rendered in a new process are lit normally (32.5 / 33.5), so it was a renderer persistent-data glitch, not the scene

decision: v1 delivered: 36.13 s, cuts verified on the delivered file (-18..+16 ms from kicks); self-review in review.md
why: Look at your own output: cuts sheet + 1 fps contact sheet checked; framing weakness in the explode orbit recorded for the next pass

decision: v2 restructure by area: whole car (uncropped) push -> FRONT: bumper lifts out into clear background and turns once to show its scanned inside -> hood opens on its hinge over the bumper-off front end -> close dolly over that front data -> REAR on the drop: trunk closed/half/open -> crane into the trunk well -> top-down: bumper slides home, hood + lid close, lock b52 -> dip to black -> small logo
why: User on v1: same revision-1 issues as the siblings (opening cropped, repetitive rotations, explode too wide/all at once, ending too long), front bumper data first then the back

decision: No turntables/orbits in v2: every move is a straight push, dolly or crane
why: Lesson (mazda-miata-nc user): rotations spend screen time without showing anything new; user called v1 steps repetitive

decision: Only the front bumper comes off; hood and trunk lid OPEN on their hinges, nothing else separates
why: Lesson: don't show a part coming off unless it was physically removed and scanned in that state - only the bumper has a removed scan ('Front Bumper Only' + 'Front End Bumper Off'); hood/trunk were only opened

decision: Bumper turns 135 deg about its width axis once, after it is out in clear air
why: Its scan includes the inside (mounting tabs, ribs - checked by rendering it from behind); lessons: spin only to show a useful backside, flip about the width axis, move parts into clear background not across the body

decision: Bumper leaves the scene after s2 and slides home from in front of the nose in the top-down
why: Parked above the nose it covered the opening hood and the engine bay in s3/s4 previews

decision: Wheel and tail-lamp close-ups dropped; detail time goes to the removed/opened areas (front structure, trunk well)
why: Lesson (c5-corvette reviewer): focus on removed areas and where the useful data is

decision: Ending: top-down hold 4 beats, dip to black 0.6 s, small logo (470 px wide) b56 -> 35.6 s (music decay) instead of 4.4 s at 860 px to 36.16 s
why: Sibling rev-1 notes: last scenes held too long; fade; small logo (Temerario)

decision: Own copy of shot.py with use_persistent_data off
why: With it on, v1 s8 (and the NC sibling's s8) lost every light mid-render

decision: Parent v2 brief + addendum applied: scene order from direction.md (scene-director stage) - whole -> front (bumper off, bumper-removed hero, hood) -> side -> rear (trunk states, trunk well) -> top-down reassembly -> dip -> small logo; each section in one continuous sequence
why: User via parent: shots poorly cropped, redundant shots of the same sections, travel front -> side -> rear without ping-pong

decision: New hero shot s3_front_removed (b16-b24, 4.4 s): move in from front-left on the bumper-off scan - crash beam with its end brackets, radiator core, wiring below - then hold; replaces s4_front_detail
why: Addendum C: bumper-removed data gets its own section, camera moves in on what is behind the bumper and holds to read it. Verified in the bumper-off scan before labelling (4 test views)

decision: Labels (ScanHUD, overlay.json): 'FRONT BUMPER / INSIDE + OUTSIDE SCANNED' as the bumper's inside turns to camera; 'FRONT BUMPER REMOVED / WHAT'S BEHIND IT, SCANNED' then 'CRASH BEAM / MOUNTING POINTS · RADIATOR' on the hero shot; no numbers
why: Addendum C asks for plain labels backed by the scan; the bumper's inside was checked by rendering it from behind, beam/brackets/radiator are visible in the bumper-off scan. Overrides the v1 'no text' brief

decision: Hood shot reused from the v2 render, trimmed to its first 4 beats (opening completes at 1.94 s of 2.23 s)
why: Only its position/length changed; saves 34 frames of render

decision: New s4b_side: low straight dolly along the right side (x -3.3 m, 35 mm), b28-b32 on the riser
why: direction.md: v2 jumped front-right close -> rear-left wide on the drop, skipping the side and flipping screen direction; first preview at x -2.45 cut the roof (addendum A) - moved out

decision: Trunk shots mirrored to the rear-right; trunk-well crane ends lower
why: Keeps screen direction from the side dolly; lid tip was clipped at the top in the preview; the well floor has see-through gaps so the crane doesn't end looking straight down

decision: Hood and trunk still open (not removed); both openings end exactly on registered open-state scans (Front End Bumper Off / Hood Open, NA Trunk Half Open / Open)
why: Addendum D: only show a state if a scan of that state of this car exists and registers - it does for both; the lid motion is a hinge between the closed car and the captured open pose

decision: Reframed s2_bumper (pulled back to ~5 m, left-front 3/4) and s3_front_removed (low, near head-on from the right, beam centred)
why: First/mid/last contact sheet showed the car's right front corner clipped on the left edge in s2 and the fascia/crash beam cut off on the right edge in s3 with the lower half of frame empty; addendum A (nothing clipped) and the user's v1 cropping complaint. s2 now also differs in side from s1 (right-front) so the cut isn't a near-repeat view. s4b_side kept as a deliberate side tracking close-up (a 3.9 m car side-on can't fill a portrait frame legibly).

decision: Moved cuts 152->151 and 685->684
why: Measured on the decoded audio of the assembled v2 (40-120 Hz envelope max rise) these two cuts were +24/+22 ms after the kick, over the +-1/2 frame rule; the grid had drifted. Now -9/-12 ms; all 8 cuts within -12..+16 ms.

decision: Kept s3_hood/s4b_side/s5_trunk despite ive director 'repeated view' flags
why: Best-matching frames were front-3/4 hood-open vs driver door, and rear wheel vs rear-3/4 trunk (v2chk/rep.png): different subjects/angles. The silhouette IoU is inflated by the car's horizontal band filling mid-frame. Not a repeat; s4b is the side section between front and rear.

decision: s1_reveal camera ease out2 -> linear, re-rendered
why: ive director flagged 0.9 s 'dead' at the end of the opening: the ease-out tail fell below the motion threshold right before the bumper cut. Linear keeps the push alive into the cut.

decision: Explode base rebuilt as comp_explode2: removed base triangles ahead of the front tyres (y<-1660 mm) and below the hood line (z<650) that are >12 mm from the 'Front End Bumper Off' capture (136,823 tris); s1 now uses that base + the bumper part at home
why: Reviewer: the old bumper still showed after the new bumper came off. The full-car scan carries a different (old) bumper - round fog-lamp holes, lower chin - than 'Front Bumper Only'; composite.py only cut car skin within 9 mm of the removed part, so the non-matching old-bumper geometry stayed. The bumper-off state scan is the truth for that zone. s1 used car4 (old bumper), so the s1->s2 cut also swapped bumpers.

decision: End card = 'now available' CTA from the MOBILE listing: illumaesthetic.com/products/mazda-miata-na-3d-scan-1989-1997 captured with Playwright iPhone 13 (390x780 css, 3x), WebZoom tight on the product title -> phone frame 580 px, 'MIATA NA SCAN NOW AVAILABLE', logo, URL last; replaces the logo-only card in the same slot (dip on b56 31.7 s)
why: User asked for the CTA using the mobile site. Listing title/price/dataset are the live page (00, 'Exterior Only' is the only dataset). Hid one third-party pin image (mappy.tech-arms.io, blocked from this sandbox -> broken-image icon over ADD TO CART) and swiped the 360 viewer once to clear the 'Drag to rotate' hint; nothing else edited. Zoom 36 frames so the URL holds ~1.3 s before the end; the card holds (no fade to black) while the music decays.

decision: WebZoom.tsx: optional endWidth, pageCenterY, titleTop, radius, titleFrom props
why: A tall phone screenshot needs a narrower page, its own vertical layout and a title that starts after the zoom (otherwise it fades in over the moving page). Defaults reproduce the old landscape layout, so other reels are unchanged.

decision: v3: dropped s6_trunk_well; s5_trunk holds on the open trunk instead
why: Reviewer: the zoom into the trunk is unnecessary. The open-trunk hold at the end of s5 already shows the well.

decision: Base comp_explode3: front zone (y<-1660, z<650 mm) taken wholesale from the 'Front End Bumper Off' capture; full-car geometry there dropped
why: Reviewer: crash beam partially clipped. composite.py only added fill >7 mm from the car INCLUDING the removed bumper skin, so beam surfaces close to the old bumper's inner face were never added (hole in the lower-left beam). comp_explode2 then removed the old-bumper remnants but could not restore the beam. The bumper-off state scan is the truth for the whole zone; verified the full beam on a render.

decision: Cover camera solved: loc (2.558,-4.630,2.373) target (-0.002,-0.524,0.388), 43.98 mm on a 36 mm sensor (= 24.74 mm on the 20.25 mm shot sensor); silhouette IoU 0.976 vs the listing cover (tools/coversolve.py), Blender grey check overlay aligns hood seams, headlamps, wheels
why: User: the parts-go-home shot must match the website cover photo frame for a 1:1 transition. The cover is a grey render of the same full-car scan, so a silhouette fit of car4 recovers its camera.

decision: Ending: s7 swings from top-down onto the cover camera (lands beat 7, holds ~0.6 s) -> HARD cut on n98 (30.87 s, section change) into the mobile listing showing the cover slide (Photos tab, slide 1) at 1080 px wide centred y=960 -> WebZoom pulls back to the phone frame, title, logo, URL
why: 1:1 = same car pose and size on both sides of a cut on a beat (house rule: the transformation cut is never a dissolve). WebZoom startScale 1080/877.5, focus = cover centre (585, 467) in the 3x screenshot. Known difference: the cover shows the full-car scan's own bumper (round fog lamps); the reassembled car has the removable bumper.

decision: Music v3: user-supplied track, 186.7 BPM grid t = 0.0628 + 0.32132 n (phase fold over onset peaks, +-6 ms over the first minute), started at 0.68 s so the first note is at 0; 8-beat phrases with downbeats n = 2 + 8k; shot BEAT = 2 track beats (0.643 s) so the v2 motion keys stay on the music; all cuts on phrase downbeats
why: librosa's first estimate (94 BPM) and a 0.325 s period drifted ~0.15 cycle per 6 s; folding onset peaks over candidate periods found 0.32132 s with stable phase. Per-beat low-end peaks every 8 beats mark the phrase downbeats.

decision: assemble: cuts are 1-frame xfades, so the new shot first appears at frame c+1; s1 dur 155->154 frames and cta 154->155 so every cut is seen on its planned frame
why: measured on the decoded v3 picture: all 7 cuts showed one frame late (+33 ms) vs the plan; total stays 1080 frames

decision: cut 463->464 (s3_front_removed 155 f, s3_hood 77 f)
why: decoded audio onset at 15.456 s; 463 was -22 ms (> half frame), 464 is +11 ms

decision: kept director flags: s3_hood~s4b_side, s4b_side~s5_trunk repeats; s3_front_removed 1.9 s slow tail; cta 2.2 s hold
why: repeats are different subjects (as in v2); s3 tail is a slow 8 cm creep under the CRASH BEAM label so it reads; cta hold is URL reading time

decision: 1:1 cut s7->cta verified
why: s7 last frame vs cta frame 0 overlay: car silhouettes coincide to a few px (cover camera solve IoU 0.976); only difference is the page's grey photo backdrop and UI appearing
